primary_meaning: A group falsely claiming to be God's true people (Jews) who actually serve Satan by opposing and persecuting faithful Christians

alternatives.meaning: Specific first-century Jewish synagogue communities in Smyrna and Philadelphia that slandered and opposed local Christian churches
basis: historical context of Roman Asia Minor

alternatives.meaning: Any false or apostate religious assembly that pretends to piety while opposing true believers (broader symbolic application to false religion or counterfeit church)
Judaism or ethnic Jews collectively as perpetual enemies of the church
Judaizing Christians or internal false teachers claiming Mosaic privilege

notes: The paired phrasing equates the OT 'assembly of the wicked' (e.g., Ps 22:16) with the NT 'synagogue of Satan.' Mainstream Christian teaching converges on the core idea of false claimants to covenant status who persecute the faithful; debates concern scope (local historical vs. typological) rather than the basic symbolic sense.
